claim_boundary: This protocol defines only a fixed-geometry, frozen-permanent-source direct-sum KKT structural gate. It uses a synthetic reciprocal continuum in unit tests. It does not perform a physical PCM calculation, make the MACE permanent source variational, provide a total solvation free energy, force, PES, QM solvent-physics result, or experimental accuracy result.

construction.name: route2-v0-atomic-displacement-frozen-kkt-v1
construction.permanent_source: The unmodified zero-field MACE-POLAR raw point monopole/dipole coefficients c0 are mapped to the declared surface only by the existing point_multipole_potential convention.
construction.induced_source: The V0-ADT free-atom translation tangent maps the induced molecular dipole p to the same surface directly from the frozen radial table; it is not GTO-projected.
construction.direct_sum_dual: For one surface charge q, (S^T q, B^T q) is built from exactly the dense forward maps (S,B), so q^T(S c0+B p)=c0^T S^Tq+p^T B^Tq.
construction.stationary_scalar: g(p;c0)=0.5 p^T alpha_theta^-1 p + 0.5 (S c0+B p)^T Q (S c0+B p), with c0 frozen and p stationary.
construction.linearity_gate: The returned total surface charge must equal Q(S c0)+Q(B p) to the declared tolerance; an affine/nonlinear response is rejected even if its restricted induced Hessian appears reciprocal.

required_structural_gates: Point-multipole and V0-ADT sources have exactly the same atomic geometry and surface points.
Both permanent and induced source duals are the transpose of their corresponding forward surface maps.
The frozen MACE source meets its declared total-charge constraint without projection.
The reduced V0-ADT polarizability, continuum reciprocity, joint curvature, stationary residual, passive response, and energy ledger gates pass.

The full [S|B]-restricted continuum response is reciprocal, maps the zero source to zero, satisfies linear superposition at the declared frozen source and stationary induced response, and passes the direct-sum pairing identity.
A frozen-source scaling finite difference satisfies the stationary envelope identity.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not fit or project V0-ADT into a GTO radial channel.
Do not rescale the permanent source or polarizability in a physical calculation.
Do not select a continuum equation, cavity, radius, grid, or tolerance from a solvation error.
Do not call c0 a stationary all-electron density or call this a full Route-2V functional.
Do not run FreeSolv, MNSol, or another experimental accuracy panel from this structural gate.
physical_binding_required_before_any_acc: An independently source-bound physical continuum/cavity with a smooth-coordinate certificate.
The frozen twelve-record, ten-functional-group QM density/MEP/reaction-potential physics gates with no experimental solvation labels.
A declared treatment of the frozen permanent MACE source versus a full electronic functional, plus all force and runtime gates.
The immutable historical FreeSolv10 all-record maximum-error test, then broad development, confirmation, and blind experimental panels.
decision_rule: Failure of any source/dual, linearity, curvature, stationarity, physical, force, runtime, or all-record accuracy gate rejects the frozen candidate. It does not authorize fitting, retraining, calibration, response modification, GTO-width selection, or cavity/radius tuning.
